name: airtable-interface-extension-testing
description: Testing library and fixture tooling for Airtable interface extensions (interface-alpha Blocks SDK)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @usdr/airtable-interface-testing && npm run build -w @usdr/airtable-interface-testing-fixtures
scripts.pack:release: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true})" && npm pack -w @usdr/airtable-interface-testing -w @usdr/airtable-interface-testing-fixtures --pack-destination release
